column1: # Canonical bankable potion families. Variant values are explicit because item IDs are not arithmetic.
# Standard grimy -> clean herb workflow stages. Family direction is supported by the reviewed
# ten-template Ironman cohort; canonical item relationships are pinned to the OSRS Wiki source.
# Clean herb -> unfinished potion stages. Stage 2 remains reserved for a future evidence-backed
# seed policy; the unfinished product uses its intended recipe-row column at stage 3.
# Raw -> processed resource stages. Only canonical bankable IDs are included; noted/cert,
# placeholder, and same-name contextual variants are deliberately excluded.
# Light and heavy ballista share components. The sequence follows the assembly workflow,
# while complete usable ballistae remain combat weapons outside this resource family.
# Charged jewellery slice 1. CHARGE 0 is the uncharged state; Integer.MAX_VALUE is the
# explicit never-degrading sentinel. Membership comes from the local RuneLite gameval index.
# Charged jewellery slice 2. The two ring-of-wealth state groups use explicit stable
# family keys so the imbued charge run sorts before the standard charge run.
